name: ya_lsp
description: A standalone Ruby language server. No Ruby runtime required.

ya-lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to a `ya-lsp` binary to use instead of the one bundled with this extension. Point it at `target/release/ya-lsp` to develop against a local build. `~` and `${workspaceFolder}` are expanded.

ya-lsp.logLevel.markdownDescription: How much the server writes to the ya-lsp output channel. Read from the environment when the server starts, so changing it restarts the server.

ya-lsp.gems.enabled.markdownDescription: Index the project's gems, so that go-to-definition and completion reach into them. Turning this off makes startup slightly faster and everything else worse.

ya-lsp.gems.defaultGems.markdownDescription: Index the gems that ship inside Ruby itself — `json`, `uri`, `forwardable`, `optparse` and about forty others. Their directories under `gems/` are empty placeholders, so without this they resolve to nothing and `require "json"` leads nowhere.

ya-lsp.gems.rubyVersion.markdownDescription: Which Ruby's gems to index, as in `3.3.0`. Leave empty to detect it from `.ruby-version`, `Gemfile.lock`, or `.tool-versions`.

ya-lsp.rbs.enabled.markdownDescription: Index Ruby's own core signatures, so `String`, `Array`, `Hash` and `Kernel` have members to complete and documentation to hover. Comes from the `rbs` gem when one is installed, and from a copy inside ya-lsp when none is.

ya-lsp.rbs.stdlib.markdownDescription: Also index the standard library's signatures — `CSV`, `URI`, `Logger`, `OptionParser` and ~57 others. Adds about 3.5 ms to every request, so turn it off on a very large project that only needs the core classes.

ya-lsp.rbs.path.markdownDescription: An explicit directory of RBS signatures — one holding `core/`, usually an unpacked `rbs` gem. Leave empty to find one automatically.

ya-lsp.diagnostics.rules.markdownDescription: How loudly an individual rule reports, keyed by the rule name shown in the problem's `code`. Most rules ship `off` because they fire on correct Ruby; `{ "dynamic-ancestor": "warning" }` turns one back on.

ya-lsp.index.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Refuse to index a workspace larger than this rather than thrashing.

ya-lsp.trace.server.description: Log the LSP traffic between VS Code and ya-lsp. For debugging the extension itself.
